newsitem.title: USA: DuPont upgrades to boost Texas plant output.
newsitem.headline: DuPont upgrades to boost Texas plant output.

text.p: DuPont Co said Friday it expects upgrading its polyvinyl alcohol manufacturing plant in LaPorte, Texas, will boost output by about 20 percent by the end of 2000.

The chemical and energy company said the plant upgrade, which includes installing advanced technology in the finishing area, will add capacity in 1998. DuPont added it expected more improvements over the next three following years, ending in a planned 20-percent manufacturing boost at the end of 2000.
A DuPont spokesman was not immediately available to say how much the company plans to spend on upgrading the plant.
Polvinyl alcohol, sold under the name Elvanol by its Packaging and Industrial Polymers business, is used in textiles and paper sizing markets.
